about.title: Cotati Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Cotati is a small place — about 7,445 people — and when a family here loses someone suddenly, the absence is felt along Old Redwood Highway and E Cotati Avenue, not just at home. In 2025 the city recorded 23 injury collisions and 26 people hurt, with no traffic deaths reported that year. That count is a relief, yet wrongful death claims in Sonoma County come from more than roadways: a fall on unsafe property, a defective product, a medical error, or a crash on Highway 116 in another year. California treats these as civil matters, apart from any criminal case the district attorney may or may not bring. The law names who may file — a spouse or domestic partner and children first, then certain dependents and heirs — and generally allows two years from the date of death, less if a public entity is involved. LawProactive is not a law firm. We simply connect Cotati families, at no charge, with an independent attorney who handles these cases on contingency, so you can ask questions before deciding anything.

items.title: Clarity on who can file
items.desc: California limits standing to a spouse or domestic partner and children first, then certain dependents and heirs. An attorney can sort out your family's position quietly and early, before anything is filed.

items.title: The two-year clock explained
items.desc: Most wrongful death actions must be brought within two years of the date of death, and claims involving a government entity carry a much shorter window. Knowing which deadline applies to your situation is the first practical step.

items.title: Every category of loss considered
items.desc: Recoverable damages include funeral and burial costs, the financial support your loved one would have provided, and the loss of love, companionship, and guidance. The attorney you're connected with works on contingency, so there is no fee unless there is a recovery.

items.question: Cotati reported no traffic deaths in 2025. Does that affect a wrongful death claim here?
items.answer: No. Public collision counts describe a single year on roads like Rt 116 and Old Redwood Highway; they do not limit any individual family's rights. Wrongful death claims also arise from medical care, unsafe premises, defective products, and workplaces, none of which appear in traffic statistics. What matters is whether another party's negligence caused the death.

items.question: The person responsible was never charged. Can we still bring a claim?
items.answer: Yes. A wrongful death case is a civil action and does not depend on a criminal prosecution or conviction. The standard of proof is different, and the purpose is to compensate the family rather than to punish. An attorney can evaluate the facts independently of what the Sonoma County District Attorney decided.

items.question: What if a city, county, or Caltrans may share responsibility?
items.answer: Claims against a public entity in California follow special rules, including a much shorter deadline than the usual two years. That can matter when a death involves a state route such as Highway 116 or a city-maintained street. Because the timeline is compressed, it helps to speak with an attorney as soon as you feel able.
